# Respawn Club

> Respawn Club runs international gaming prize draws. Its first campaign, the "GTA VI Legendary Drop", has three winners: a PlayStation 5 Pro with Grand Theft Auto VI, a copy of Grand Theft Auto VI, and a $50 PlayStation Store or Steam gift card.

Respawn Club is operated by a United States limited liability company with international operations.

## Key facts
- Prizes: 1st PlayStation 5 Pro + Grand Theft Auto VI; 2nd Grand Theft Auto VI (physical or digital, subject to availability); 3rd $50 gift card (PlayStation Store or Steam)
- Entries: 15,000 in total, maximum 100 per account, USD $0.99 per entry
- Payment: PayPal
- Draw: held only after at least 60% of entries are sold; the closing date is not confirmed yet (estimated January–February 2027, depending on sales)
- Languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese
- Social: Instagram and TikTok @rickyrespawn06
